The '''Baylagon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within [[Arrowhead]], a region in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with [[Baylagon Technical Institute]].<ref name="Certain Point of View">{{JournalCite|8|A Certain Point of View (short story)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Baylagon system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square M-10.<ref name="TEA" />
